turns.prompt:
You are given one attached CSV file:
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

No property values are provided. Using your knowledge of crystal optics,
crystal symmetry and structure-property relationships, predict each
candidate's birefringence at 1064 nm, then select the 5 candidates whose
birefringence is CLOSEST to 0.1.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, closest first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The birefringence \(\Delta n\) at 1064 nm is identically zero in cubic crystals (optically isotropic). It remains small (\(\lesssim 0.05\)) in tetrahedral diamond-like, chalcopyrite, defect-chalcopyrite and SiC-polytype networks whose lattice distortions from cubic/hexagonal ideality are modest. Substantially larger values appear only when an additional microscopic anisotropy is present: stereo-active lone pairs (Ge\(^{2+}\), Sn\(^{2+}\), Sb\(^{3+}\), Tl\(^{+}\)) or aligned planar \(\pi\)-groups (BS\(_3\)).

Inspection of the POSCAR lattices and atomic coordinates identifies five structures in which these anisotropic units are only moderately aligned or the cell metric is only moderately elongated. Their estimated \(\Delta n\) therefore cluster tightly around the target value 0.1:

- c041 (Na\(_2\)Sr\(_2\)B\(_2\)S\(_6\)): BS\(_3\) triangles present but not all coplanar \(\to \Delta n \approx 0.100\)
- c084 (Rb\(_2\)Sn\(_2\)Cl\(_6\)): stereo-active Sn\(^{2+}\) in a weakly compressed tetragonal cell \(\to \Delta n \approx 0.095\)
- c048 (YCuSe\(_2\)): hexagonal metric \(c/a \approx 1.57\) with mixed Cu/Y coordination \(\to \Delta n \approx 0.105\)
- c086 (Rb\(_4\)Ge\(_4\)Cl\(_{12}\)): Ge\(^{2+}\) lone pairs, cell axes comparable to c084 \(\to \Delta n \approx 0.110\)
- c063 (Rb\(_4\)Ge\(_4\)Br\(_{12}\)): same lone-pair motif but more polarizable Br \(\to \Delta n \approx 0.130\)

All other candidates lie farther from 0.1 (either \(\Delta n = 0\), \(\Delta n \lesssim 0.05\) or \(\Delta n \gtrsim 0.15\)).

Final: c041, c084, c048, c086, c063
